author: DaFrozenBlaze
body: Whenever I try to connect to something on teamspeak, it says "cannot resolve hostname", any way to fix it?
body_tagged: Whenever I try to connect to something on teamspeak, it says "cannot resolve hostname", any way to fix it?
title: Teamspeak help

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: Do you have the right IP and a stable internet connection?

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Well, the Ip is ts.avicus.net .
Maybe try just avicus.net
Can you connect to other teamspeak servers?
If yes go into the command line (CMD) and type "ipconfig /flushdns" without the ""
